parameters.query:
-- What Meta accepted, so n8n/fms-whatsapp-status.json can record what
-- happened to it and resend it if it failed. Never fails the request: a
-- missing table (migration 029 not deployed yet) only loses the tracking.
INSERT INTO whatsapp_messages (wamid, title, message) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
ON CONFLICT (wamid) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, message = EXCLUDED.message
RETURNING wamid
